_meta.denominator: team targets/air yards summed over GAMES PLAYED, never the full season

pairs_with.rule: BOTH vintages render, always. The prior season is never overwritten and the current one never silently replaces it.

trend_rules.both_sides: `trend` is the PASSING side, `trend_car` the RUSHING side. A back can be flat in one and moving in the other — RJ Harvey 2025 reads stable on target share while his touches doubled. Read both for RBs.
trend_rules.insufficient: means not enough games to split, NOT a flat role. Never render it as stable.
trend_rules.rank: 1 — role/opportunity CHANGE, which outranks the season aggregate sitting beside it
trend_rules.windows: calendar (W1-9 vs W10-18) only on a complete season, otherwise halves of the weeks covered. The two are different measurements and never comparable.
